beats.rationale: Large kinetic type and a transforming voice signal make the new Voice-to-workflow state legible before the narration finishes.
Three actual spatial device objects communicate web, iOS and Android availability without reverting to three flat information cards.
Directed animated routes and endpoint signals explain how a Voice request reaches available plugins and connected apps.
The spoken command visibly changes into work artifacts in depth, showing creation as an object transformation rather than a feature list.
One uninterrupted route survives the closing voice call and becomes a text task, making continuity visible as a single moving process.
Concentric constraints and lock signals turn permissions and usage limits into visible boundaries instead of another warning panel.
The final conclusion is the memorable object itself: large type assembles around a workflow hub while supporting shapes resolve the story.
